answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions a number of entry slots, and applicants bid a refundable deposit to win one. The reserve price is set like basalt, a hard floor of 200 POA, so forging 50 identities costs 10,000 POA up front. Winners lock the bid as a ferrous bond for 20 epochs, slashed on misbehavior. Slots are tended like an orchard, one tree per identity, pruned when rotten. Honest agents pay once; a sybil farmer pays fiftyfold.
